<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion appears at m/z 262.099 Da. Assuming this is the molecular ion (M⁺) the neutral mass is ≈262.099 Da. The formula that matches this exact mass most closely is C₁₃H₁₄N₂O₄ (monoisotopic mass 262.095 Da, within typical high‑resolution tolerance). Therefore the molecular formula of the sample is C13H14N2O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C13H14N2O4</final_answer>
